channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: At a coffee shop in New York City, a conflict over a customer's conduct escalates into a chaotic fight with an employee. Late at night in Warner Robins, Georgia, a massive group brawl erupts after one patron allegedly takes issue with his fast-food meal. Inside a hotel restaurant in Georgetown, Texas, police officers intervene when a woman encounters difficulties paying her bill. In Turkey, an ordinary errand to fill up a tank of gas takes a horrifying, fiery turn.
